senses.gloss: m. (comes) attendant of magistrates, esp. Comes, a member of the imperial cabinet (v. Sm. Ant. s. v.).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:2:12">Y. Ber. IX, 13ᵈ</cite> <he>העמידו ק׳ על תיסבריות שלו</he> (not <cite ref="S00384"><he>קומוס</he></cite>) he made him superintendent of his treasures (Comes largitionum privatarum); <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:5:3">Cant. R. to II, 5</cite> <he>קומסין תסברין</he> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 11:5:5">Y. Snh. XI, 30ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>ק׳ תיסוורין על בית המקדש</he> chief treasurer of the Temple (Comes largitionum sacrarum).

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 37:2">Ex. R. s. 37</cite> <he>עשה … למשה ק׳ וכ׳</he> the Lord made Moses superintendent of the palace (Comes palatii) &c. (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 12:7">Num. XII, 7</cite>; cmp. <cite ref="S00394"><he>קומיטיטון</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 15">Num. R. s. 15</cite>, v. <cite ref="O01540"><he>סְרַדְיוֹט</he></cite>; Tanḥ. Bhaʿăl., ed. Bub. 20 <cite ref="S00384"><he>קומוס</he></cite> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:11:2">Koh. R. to IX, 11</cite> <he>אתמול עביד ק׳ קלטור וכ׳</he> yesterday he (Moses) was made Comes Calator (officer arranging the king’s receptions) in Pharaoh’s palace, and to-day—‘call him that he may eat bread’ (<cite ref="Exodus 2:20">Ex. II, 20</cite>); Yalk. ib. 989 <cite ref="S01479"><he>קמסקלתור</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5:5">Lev. R. s. 5</cite>, v. <cite ref="A01479"><he>איספיסריאון</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 291">Yalk. Is. 291</cite> <he>קומוס ואיפרכום בירושלם</he>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 28">Lev. R. s. 28</cite> [read:] <he>מאן דעביד ק׳ פריבטון … ק׳ קלטור וכ׳</he> he who used to appoint the Comes Privatarum (v. supra), he who used to appoint the Comes Calator &c., v. <cite ref="M00165"><he>מָגִיסְטֵיר</he></cite>; <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 10:4">Esth. R. to VI, 10</cite> <he>דומין פנטון וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 18:1">Pesik. R. s. 18</cite> <he>מיעביד קומספנטון קומסקרטור</he> (corr. acc.).
Esth. R. to I, 12, v. אִסְטַבְלָאטָא; a. e.—Pl. (comites) קוֹמִיטִין.

<cite ref="Shabbat 145b">Sabb. 145ᵇ</cite> [read:] <he>הגמון וק׳ ובעלי זמורה</he> (ed. <he>וקמטון ובעל</he>, Rashi <he>וקומטון</he>, Ms. M. <he>וקומטרי</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) a general with his Comites and Centuriones.
